Planning in Burgess Hill

Silverdale Road, St John's and Fairfield

Mid Sussex District Council's summary lists three conservation areas under Burgess Hill: Silverdale Road and Birchwood Grove Road, designated in 1982, then St John's, around St John's Park just north of the town centre, and Fairfield, west of London Road, both designated in 1989. The council has 36 across the district.

On Silverdale Road the council names brick, clay tile hanging, render and ornamental roof ridge tiles among the things that make up the area's character. In St John's it points to the town houses along Park Road and Crescent Road and to the brickwork, and in Fairfield to the use of brick in most of the buildings. If your house is in any of the three and the work would change how the roof looks, speak to the council's planners before it starts.

Source: Mid Sussex District Council: conservation areas
